gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-ysabeau: Ysabeau sweeps its curves wide and never lets them close up, giving text a friendly, open flow. Red Hat Display heads it with marker-like lines, bold and sunlit inside every bend.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-ysabeau-infant: Oswald packs its rows of text tightly together, giving every heading a confident, upright stance. Ysabeau Infant adds friendly sans-serif warmth underneath.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-saira: Saira stays crisp and quiet. Metamorphous, with its roomy sidebearings and softly shaded strokes, gives the pairing its strongest quality: a distinctive, commanding headline above a modern sans.
gen-almendra-display-fs-supreme: Supreme sets a heavy, crisp strip of sans text with its letters held wide open. Almendra Display handles ornate, literary flourish with a tall x-height, while Supreme does the plain, steady work of carrying words.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Eater's thin strokes sit beside weighty stems with wide gaps between letters, giving it a dark, aggressive bite. Noto Sans Telugu answers with a plain sans body whose high midline and connected counters keep the text easy to follow.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Noto Sans Tangsa reads with wide, inviting round letters and short ascender stems, friendly and approachable. Flavors, meanwhile, is the showman, with a towering x-height and tubing-thick strokes, while the body simply gets on with being readable.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Noto Sans Vithkuqi keeps its a, c, e and s open. Autour One brings a bold, expressive headline with steady line thickness, and the two share a minimal step from capitals to lowercase.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-numans: Numans spaces its swollen lowercase well past normal, with s ends hanging far from the spine. Funnel Display, with its paperclip-bent strokes of one width, is the pair's boldest quality, commanding attention.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-prompt: Goldman's round forms curve like open parentheses. Its widely spaced letters and big lowercase give the headline presence, while Prompt's oversized small letters and open apertures keep the sans-serif body easy to take in.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-preahvihear: Grandstander draws plain constant-width lines with short ascenders and a tall x-height, bold and playful. Preahvihear echoes that lofty x-height in a plain sans, which ties the two together.
